name: review-agent-pi
description: pi 内核线的 Review CLI 产品仓：一次检视产出英文 findings + 中文按行分组建议（ADR-0024）

scripts.build:pi: pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-telemetry run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/chord run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-ai run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-agent-core run build
scripts.experiment: pnpm build:pi && pnpm --filter review-llm build && pnpm --filter review-pi build && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.experiment.json && node .tmp-gen/scripts/run-experiment.js
scripts.alignment-gate: pnpm exec tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2023 --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --skipLibCheck --outDir .tmp-gen scripts/run-alignment-gate.ts && node .tmp-gen/scripts/run-alignment-gate.js
scripts.reference: pnpm exec tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2023 --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --skipLibCheck --outDir .tmp-gen scripts/run-claude-code-reference.ts && node .tmp-gen/scripts/run-claude-code-reference.js
scripts.analyze:phase2: pnpm exec tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2023 --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --skipLibCheck --rootDir . --outDir .tmp-gen scripts/analyze-phase2.ts && node .tmp-gen/scripts/analyze-phase2.js
scripts.analyze:p5b: pnpm exec tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2023 --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --skipLibCheck --rootDir . --outDir .tmp-gen scripts/analyze-p5b.ts && node .tmp-gen/scripts/analyze-p5b.js
scripts.materialize:vul4j: pnpm exec tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2023 --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --skipLibCheck --outDir .tmp-gen scripts/materialize-vul4j.ts && node .tmp-gen/scripts/materialize-vul4j.js
